decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost extension of the established floor-care range. Two years after launch, any weak results can still be put down to market build-up, so management continues to back it.
The maintenance oil line has several models and supports the announced surface-treatment offer. That investment and visible commitment make continuing it the natural choice.
The care line for oiled floors is tied to the firm's oiled-floor business and was launched with several models. Its sunk costs and strategic fit justify keeping it.
The moisture-protection underlay is a natural accessory to the flooring systems. Management attributes any slow uptake to temporary market conditions and keeps it.

The high-density underlay completes the accessory portfolio the firm committed to. It is a single model and easier to drop than the others, but management has no strong grounds to reverse its launch decision.
The oak parquet line is at the core of the firm's production investment and brand, so dropping it is very unlikely.
